expected.subject: Priya, quick note from Legora
expected.body:
Hi Priya,

I noticed you joined our webinar last week — hoping it was useful.

Firms like BAHR are already using Legora to cut contract review time by around 60%.

We run a live demo webinar each week — save a seat here: [WEBINAR_LINK].

William
Legora

notes: 6-lawyer UK firm → SMB tier → webinar CTA. Webinar attendee but no trial means interest is warm but not hot.
